title: What's Hiding Inside an Apple?
description:
Crunchy, round, and it grows on a tree. Do you know what's inside? Pip the strawberry and Kiko the broccoli finds out! 🍓🥦

Apple! Apples grow on trees. What's hiding inside an apple? Little seeds! They make a star shape. Can you pretend to pick an apple from a tree? Reach up high!
